cards.title: Available Firepower
cards.subtitle: Balance Sheet & Credit
cards.description: Exiting low-margin distribution assets lifted Pet gross margin to ~40%; cash and ABL credit enable scale M&A.
cards.reasoning: Confirms liquidity readiness and balance sheet dry powder for immediate transaction.

cards.title: Margin Expansion
cards.subtitle: Clinically Backed Wellness
cards.description: Functional soft chews avoid commodity food risk while expanding gross margins to 55%+ with repeat cash flow.
cards.reasoning: Directly delivers on CEO Niko Lahanas's gross and EBITDA margin expansion mandate.

cards.title: Retail Door Moat
cards.subtitle: Mass & Pet Specialty
cards.description: Plugs immediately into Central's 28,000+ retail doors across Walmart, Target, Chewy, and Petco.
cards.reasoning: Captures instant retail distribution advantages across tier-1 omnichannel channels.

cards.title: Capacity Absorption
cards.subtitle: Plant Network Integration
cards.description: Absorbs unutilized soft-chew capacity across existing Nylabone and TDBBS manufacturing plants.
cards.reasoning: Drives operating leverage and lowers unit costs through internal manufacturing absorption.

slides.title: Disciplined 18-Month Execution Horizon and Decision Milestones
slides.message: Clear governance and gating review milestones ensure rapid distribution integration and synergy capture.
slides.speaker_notes: Phased implementation roadmap separating bilateral exclusivity, door rollout, and manufacturing absorption.

steps.title: Bilateral Exclusivity
steps.subtitle: Months 1-3
steps.description: Execute definitive agreement, complete confirmatory diligence, and secure FTC regulatory clearance.

steps.title: Commercial Door Rollout
steps.subtitle: Months 4-9
steps.description: Introduce SKUs into Walmart, Target, and Chewy direct-to-cart pipelines using Central sales force.

steps.title: Manufacturing Absorption
steps.subtitle: Months 10-18
steps.description: Migrate co-manufactured volume into internal Nylabone and Cadet extrusion/soft-chew plants.

slides.message: Proceeding with bilateral exclusivity delivers accretive repeat velocity and long-term shareholder value.
